variant.author: Ennea
variant.changelog:
# 1.0.0.3
- Added a true toggle option for tap release, so the cursor can stay free until you tap the modifier again.
- The existing “release until world click or next tap” behavior is still available and remains the default.
- Made tap release safer around Alt+Tab and other modifier combinations.
- Clarified several settings descriptions, especially tap release, resume behavior, and LMB + RMB movement.
variant.description: Adding and removing items to and from the list of very important items can be done in the plugin's configuration window and by right-clicking items in the game. Very important items get their name highlighted in the tooltip, and a sound effect plays in addition to that to ensure you've seen its presence.
variant.name: Very Important Item
variant.punchline: Tag items as important, highlighting them visually. Now with sound!
